name: Hannibal Barca
summary: Carthage's greatest general. He invaded Italy over the Alps and won Rome's worst defeats, but never took the city.
moments: Crosses the Alps into Italy, 218 BCE
Destroys a Roman army at Cannae, 216 BCE
Defeated by Scipio at Zama, 202 BCE
fate: Hunted by Rome in exile, he took poison rather than be handed over, c. 183 BCE.
